english: The setup result appears after the current paste and queued input finish.
The summary is a snapshot of all configured server sessions, channel and query views, activity, pending work, and file transfers.
Mentions can also be unread messages; their counts are not added together.
Press r in the summary reader to refresh from current state. Reading or refreshing does not send an IRC command.
This reader retains the result while you inspect it. The underlying conversation and unfinished command remain available.
Mentions collect messages that matched your nickname or watch terms. Their original conversations remain separate.
The server log contains connection information and replies. /join opens a channel; /list searches the network's channels; /disconnect closes this connection.
A query is a private conversation on its server. /me sends an action, /whois requests information, and /close closes its local view.
A channel is a shared conversation on its server. /me sends an action, /topic reads or edits its topic, /users lists its users, and /part leaves it.
{item} is displayed in the command response reader.
